content.comment_body: Hello, I've installed [product_name] [version_no]. In this version, my 'Update center' button is still greyed out, just like in all previous versions. Is there something I am missing? Kind regards, [user_name]

There is no [product_name] ([abbreviation]) [version_no]. That number refers only to the firmware version of a basic module. Do you mean the "Update center" option in the Help menu? If yes: The "Update center" menu option has not been functional for many years. If you want to update or upgrade your [product_name] version, you will need to search for updates/upgrades on the [company_name] website.

analysis.insight_summary: A user notes that the 'Update center' button in [product_name] is always disabled, both now and in previous releases. Another user confirms that this button has not worked for several years, leading to confusion about how updates are managed. Users are experiencing uncertainty due to unclear interface behavior and lack of direct update features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the 'Update center' button within [product_name] to work and provide a way to update or upgrade the application directly.
